notes_for_editor: Height is unresolved: the state file and Central US Lookouts say 100 ft, the register says 79 ft 6 in (about 24 m). The record's height_m 30.5 follows the 100-ft figure and was not changed. Builder is unresolved: register says the Conservation Commission, Central and the state file say CCC. End year is unresolved: register says 2015, Journal Sentinel says towers leave service in 2016. No current access source was found; the FFLA standing status is undated. The FS statement covers the forest's 14 original towers, and Iron River's membership in that group is unconfirmed. Three websearch calls were used on this tower (budget two). No new photos.
